scientific_integrity: Foundational beta-binomial representation, moments and two sufficient CLT regimes are credited to prior sources; finite enumeration supports but does not prove the limit. No independent audit or validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: Requires k→∞, n-k+1→∞, and N-n→∞; one marginal order statistic only. No joint quantile-process theorem or uniform Gaussian approximation rate. Older negative-hypergeometric literature, especially Khan (1994), remains an unverified historical overlap risk.
title: Sharp Gaussian–Poisson boundary for growing-rank finite-population order statistics
